name: Nine Card Don
description: Nine Card Don is a trick-taking card game where players compete over nine rounds. Players are dealt cards and compete to win tricks or achieve specific scoring objectives based on game rules.

history.origins: Don is a descendant of All Fours, played in various forms in Ireland and Britain. The name was shortened from Dom Pedro in Ireland and spread from Ireland to England and Wales. Nine-card Don is played in North-West England (Cheshire, Lancashire), the West Midlands, and South Wales; also known as Chase the Nine or Chaser in Worcestershire, Herefordshire, South Shropshire and the Black Country. Popular in pub leagues in Lancashire and South Wales (e.g. Bolton Don League, Abercarn Crib and Don League).
timeline: Modern Era: Continues to be played worldwide
